description: Release device lease(s) held by this session. With device_id, releases that device's lease; without, releases every lease this session holds. Succeeds quietly if nothing is held. With force, frees a lease this session does not hold (its token was lost, for example by an earlier session that died): give device_id and holder, the holder a DEVICE_IN_USE error names. Force works only when the user allowed force release in MobAI; when it is off, the error says how the user turns it on, so ask them.

device_id.description: Device to release. Empty = release all devices claimed by this session.

force.description: Free the lease on device_id whose holder is holder, without its token.

holder.description: With force: the lease's holder, as a DEVICE_IN_USE error names it.

name: release_device
